_: Town building knobs (towns.gd reads them). castle: where a great house's castle may stand when the first, old search (eight headings on the square's ring, all dry) finds no plot: headings around, rings out from the square (0 is the old ring; -1 hugs the square), sizes tried in order, and the share of the plot's edge that may stand over water if the keep's middle is dry.
_sets: castles: pack (the realistic kit's castle and longhall) or kit (castle_builder.gd raises each great house's castle, and house_builder.gd its hall, from the Quaternius kit, sized to the seat's rank: data/assets.json castle.kit); --castles=kit for one run. houses: pack or kit (house_builder.gd's townhouses, cottages and inn in place of the downloaded houses); --houses=kit. Kit roofs and banners take the holder's colour with team colour on (look.json team).
_density: density: how many houses a town raises (towns.gd _real_lots): base + per_size x its size, held between min and max, seat more at a great house's seat; crown: the crown's seat only (art target 01-town, plots shoulder to shoulder behind the square): extra houses, ring_pack (houses' spacing on the rings past the square as a share of their width; 0.95 elsewhere), ring_jitter (the extra gap's most, in units; 0.3 elsewhere), street_gaps (the share of street plots left as a yard or alley; 0.14 elsewhere).
_plots: layout: rings (houses on rings round the square, today's) or plots (town_plots.gd: roads first, burgage plots along them, a fenced yard behind each house; --towns=plots / --towns=rings for one run). plots: set_back (street edge to a house front), yard (a yard's depth behind its house), gap (between two plots' houses), lane_every and lane_length (branch lanes along a road), lanes_per_size and lanes_most (lanes a town lays: (size - 2) x lanes_per_size, at most lanes_most), wander (how much a street bends on level ground), edge_more (how much further the plots run than the old palisade ring), square_ring (houses enclose the square between the roads in), fence (the yards' fence: a component in assets.json), near (a house stands only within this of something already standing, the square, the castle, a landmark or a house, so a town grows out from its heart with one edge and no house alone on the fields; 0 turns it off); crown: the crown's seat's own (art target 01-town: narrow, deep plots shoulder to shoulder along winding streets), and extra, how many more houses it raises on plots.
_market: market.crown: the crown's seat's market at midday (art target 01-town: some twenty at work round the square). stalls_more (stalls past a seat's three, and the Marketplace's two), buyers (each stall's buyers, fewest and most; 1-2 elsewhere), smith (a smith at his anvil), carts (carters selling from a cart), porters (porters at the stalls' ends), square_holds (how many villagers the square holds at once with its scene folk; 5 to 10 elsewhere by size), rooms (how many each of its places holds: market, well, tavern, sept), out_most (the most of its people out by day; 40 elsewhere), farmers_to_market (the share of would-be farmers who keep a city trade at the market instead).
_props: props.sink: how far a prop on the square (stall, wagon, barrels, crates, the well) sits into the ground below the lowest of its middle and four corners (game units; 0.006 is about 5 cm), so nothing hangs over a slope.
_farms: farms.fieldRise: the most a farmstead's field's ground may rise across it (game units, about 3 m); steeper and the field is not laid (its paint was cut off in a triangle on a slope).
